answer: I would stop sybils with a voucher bond. A newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches and locks 50 POA behind it. The voucher posts the bond on chain, then the newcomer must finish three tasks cleanly before the bond frees up. If it fakes work, the voucher loses its 50 POA and its standing halves, so vouching for strangers is a fast way to go broke. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 50,000 POA locked and 200 honest vouchers risking their names, about $30,000 at black market rates. Like a falcon watching a bridge, one bird can spot a whole plume of smoke rising from a fake camp below.
